scope: Real packed native warrior controller/animator and PlayerStrikeSampler at current live-source hashes. Historical R12 seven-capsule geometry is evaluated READ-ONLY against the same actual bones, alongside actual CPU-skinned triangle/blade sweeps. No collision gates/damage are injected. Source may contain concurrent R13 work; per-hash current damage and historical shape misses are distinguished.

surface.scope: Actual CPU-skinned mesh TRIANGLES versus the real line blade sweep; no lateral assist. Time sampling has a conservative travel/(2N) distance bound. Boss pose uses the current frame, matching the live solver.
